references.text: The parable of the net that gathers fish of every kind, which are then separated into good and bad, is similar to the gathering of both evil and good people for the wedding.
The wedding in the Song of Songs, as a symbol of God's relationship with his people, can be seen in light of the wedding in the parable, where everyone is invited.
The parable of the great banquet, where many are invited but find excuses not to come, and are then replaced by other guests from the streets.
Revelation describes the wedding between the Lamb and his bride, where those who are invited are blessed. This reflects the invitation to the wedding in the parable.
